tests.name: LEAKAGE CURRENTS and PATIENT AUXILIARY CURRENTS

sub_tests.description: Electrical isolation providing protection against electric shock limits currents to values in 8.7.3
Specified values of EARTH LEAKAGE, TOUCH, PATIENT LEAKAGE, and PATIENT AUXILIARY CURRENTS applied in combination of conditions in appended Table 8.7
Allowable values specified in 8.7.3 applied under SINGLE FAULT CONDITIONS of 8.1 b)
Insulation short circuited only under conditions in 8.6.4 b) — where insulation used in conjunction with a PROTECTIVE EARTH CONNECTION
The only SINGLE FAULT CONDITION for EARTH LEAKAGE CURRENT was interruption of one supply conductor at a time
LEAKAGE CURRENTS and PATIENT AUXILIARY CURRENT not measured in SINGLE FAULT CONDITION of short circuiting of one constituent part of DOUBLE INSULATION
SINGLE FAULT CONDITIONS not applied at same time as special test conditions of MAXIMUM MAINS VOLTAGE on APPLIED PARTS and non-PROTECTIVELY EARTHED parts of ENCLOSURE
Allowable values measured based on currents in Fig 12 a) or by device measuring frequency contents as in Fig 12 b
Allowable values of PATIENT LEAKAGE and AUXILIARY CURRENTS according to Tables 3 & 4, values of a.c. relative to currents having frequency not less than 0.1 Hz
TOUCH CURRENT did not exceed 100 μA in NORMAL CONDITION and 500 μA in SINGLE FAULT CONDITION (I TNC, I TSFC)
EARTH LEAKAGE CURRENT did not exceed 5 mA in NORMAL CONDITION and 10 mA in SINGLE FAULT CONDITION (I ENC, I ESFC)

Higher values of EARTH LEAKAGE CURRENT permitted for PERMANENTLY INSTALLED ME EQUIPMENT connected to a supply circuit supplying only this ME EQUIPMENT according to local regulations or IEC 60364-7-710
LEAKAGE CURRENTS, regardless of waveform and frequency, did not exceed 10 mA r.m.s. in NORMAL or in SINGLE FAULT CONDITION (measured with non-frequency-weighted device)

semantic_fragments.content: WORKING VOLTAGE for d.c. voltages with superimposed ripple was average value when peak-to-peak ripple less than 10% of average value, or peak voltage when peak-to-peak ripple exceeding 10% of average value. Applicable to clause 8.5.4 of IEC60601-1.

WORKING VOLTAGE between PATIENT CONNECTIONS of an F-TYPE APPLIED PART and ENCLOSURE was highest voltage appearing across insulation in NORMAL USE including earthing of any part of APPLIED PART. Clause 8.5.4 of IEC60601-1.

Under clause 8.7.3, TOUCH CURRENT limits: 100 μA in NORMAL CONDITION and 500 μA in SINGLE FAULT CONDITION. EARTH LEAKAGE CURRENT limits: 5 mA in NORMAL CONDITION and 10 mA in SINGLE FAULT CONDITION. LEAKAGE CURRENTS regardless of waveform and frequency shall not exceed 10 mA r.m.s. in NORMAL or SINGLE FAULT CONDITION.
